objective: Test whether an unchanged adaptive coordinator can select and benefit from a small population of independently trained terminal specialists using only public capability metadata.

specialist_lineages.capability: Read CSV and JSON artifacts with Python; join, filter, group, reconcile, and compute exact integer results.
Inspect Python source and text configuration with Python AST and file tools; derive exact structural facts and integer results.

registry_contract.harness_responsibility: Validate registry membership and execute the authored route; never choose or replace the expert.
registry_contract.worker_responsibility: Author and execute the file computation and send one grounded parent report.

data_boundary.discovery: Existing historical worker failures and a fresh non-held-out diagnostic split may identify generic-worker weaknesses.

evaluation_conditions.generalist_control: Frozen adaptive coordinator plus H176 as the only registered terminal worker.
evaluation_conditions.specialist_population: The exact same coordinator plus frozen H176 and the two candidate specialist workers.
evaluation_conditions.treatment_difference: Available worker cognition and public registry entries only.

sequence: Implement and test registry and fail-closed expert routing.
Run a zero-update latent-routing screen with all expert ids backed by unchanged H176.
Measure the generic-only held-out control before specialist training.
Train the two H176-derived full-dense specialist candidates independently on disjoint role-local corpora.
Run the paired treatment once on the frozen held-out bank.
Run protected adaptive-depth and typed-retention gates before any promotion.
Publish only admitted lineages; otherwise retain H176 and the adaptive coordinator unchanged.
